descriptions: Uses the normal document flow and ignores top, right, bottom, and left offsets.
Remains in normal flow but can be offset from its original position.
Removed from normal flow and positioned relative to its containing block.
Positioned relative to the viewport and remains fixed during scrolling.
Behaves normally until a scroll threshold is reached, then remains stuck within its container.
